messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a cluster of fncall invocations that ended up with no schema error in traces and no routing tag. Looks like the validator returned a soft-reject but the proxy swallowed the reason. Repro: a bunch of customer requests show generation + no toolcall but no reject telemetry.
jamie: uhhhh can you paste an example response blob? :eyes:
alex: here's anonymized snippet from the proxy logs:
```
{"request_id":"r-123","model":"gpt-xyz","response":{"text":"...","tool_call":null},"validation":null}
```
no `validation` object, no `reject_reason`.
rachel: this matches complaints from support — console shows a lot of degen routing but nothing flagged as schema-reject. UX: customers see |no tool run| and we can't explain why.
diego: sounds like the validator is returning a soft-fail enum and the gateway only emits telemetry when `validation.error` exists. Soft-fails maybe set `validation=null` to avoid billing. That's our current pattern but it hides the why.
lina: we changed that behavior to avoid double-billing for rejects, but yeah, hiding reasons kills observability. proposal: always emit a thin `validation` envelope with `status:soft_reject` + `code` but mark it `billing_exempt:true`. That way routes and dashboards can surface it.
jamie: agree. Also need a metric: `fncall.validation.silent_rejects` gauge/counter with labels {region,route,model_variant}. Current `fncall.rejects` doesn't capture soft vs silent.
diego: easy to add counter in proxy and replicate to ingest. But console needs a filter and a small UI affordance: show "soft rejects" and link to sample logs. rachel can we add a row in the per-route table?
rachel: yes. but we should avoid noise — default collapsed. We'll add a badge + count and a toggled timeline. Also add link to raw request id.
alex: another wrinkle: routing policy currently treats `validation==null` as success and routes to degen fallback instead of `reject-route`. That makes quota attribution wrong. We should treat soft_rejects as a distinct routing outcome.
lina: quick patch: change gateway routing decision to check `validation?.status == 'soft_reject'` and set route_tag="soft_reject". Backwards compatible if the object is present.
jamie: SGTM. Need unit tests + a migration timeline. I can own the proxy change if someone owns console and metrics.
diego: I'll add the counter and a small event forwarder to logging pipeline. Will also emit an audit log line: `AUDIT fncall soft_reject r-123 reason=enum_mismatch`. Regex for log matching: `AUDIT fncall soft_reject (?P<req>r-[0-9]+) reason=(?P<reason>\w+)`.
rachel: UI task — i'll add dashboard card + toggle. Also add a docs blurb explaining "soft rejects" vs "hard rejects" for customer support.
alex: timeline? We should aim for a short-term mitigation (telemetry + routing change) + longer-term UX + docs. Any objections to patching routing immediately?
lina: no objections. I'll open PR for gateway change. Will add deprecation note in config so older clients still work if they truly omit `validation`.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: initiated deploy of proxy/validator-helpers to staging (deploy id d-789) by lina — started checks.
jamie: i'll write tests and coordinate with diego for metric naming. ping me when staging is healthy so i can run canary.
diego: staging logs already show `AUDIT fncall soft_reject` events. pushing to prod after canary.
rachel: I'll draft the console changes and a small changelog entry for support.
alex: awesome. Action items: lina PR (gateway routing), jamie tests + proxy code, diego metrics + audit forwarder, rachel UI + docs. Revisit in this thread when staging canary done. :thumbsup:
